one_line: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid investigations and personal disclosures, while Anthropic drew heavy IPO demand and Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen.

themes.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns
themes.text: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang resigned following personal disclosures and federal probes, leading to a steep share price drop and congressional inquiries. CFO Colette Kress was named interim CEO as the DOJ and lawmakers examine the company's chip sales and security measures.

stories.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns following revelations about personal relationships

themes.title: Anthropic IPO draws massive demand
themes.text: Anthropic’s upcoming IPO is heavily oversubscribed as the company targets a $1.4 trillion valuation. Meanwhile, AI startup LangChain raised $300 million and Mirendil secured a $1 billion Series A.

stories.headline: Anthropic IPO draws about six times the orders for available shares

themes.title: New models and security tools launched
themes.text: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen for coding and search, and OpenAI introduced its Daybreak security products. A forensic analysis also found hardware fingerprints matching Nvidia Blackwell GPUs in several recent Chinese AI models.

stories.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast model for everyday coding and search
OpenAI launches Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory security products
Forensic analysis finds six Chinese AI models show NVIDIA Blackwell GPU fingerprints
